angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,351,049 km at 228.98 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.3672 +/- 0.0141 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97): 228.98 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.942 +/- 0.043 solar radii from Simonnin et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1518 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A.314S/abstract): 1,351,049 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.88 +/- 0.13 solar masses from Simonnin et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1518 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A.314S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 7299 +/- 98 K from Simonnin et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1518 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A.314S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Simonnin et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1518 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A.314S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1518.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.136, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1518 (pscomppars): spectral type F0, from Cabot et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..218C/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+66 1610: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1518 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.1 dex, from Simonnin et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A.314S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1518 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.98408, from Simonnin et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A.314S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2210596444367488384, flags_flame 00: age_flame 0.9574713 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 0.76667535 to 1.1482453)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1518 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 85.1 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
